# NativeFlow

> Turn any YouTube video or podcast you love into a language lesson, without leaving the experience.

NativeFlow helps intermediate language learners understand and stay engaged with authentic podcasts and videos. Paste a YouTube URL, pick the language you want explanations in, and tap sentences in the transcript whenever you need help.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Paste a YouTube URL and learn from any video with sentence-level explanations.
- [My Expressions](/saved): Your personal collection of useful sentences and expressions saved from videos.
